title: Redshift Introduces Quickdraw Saddle Bag
content:
The Redshift Quickdraw Saddle Bag features a simple quick release mounting system to keep tools in place and make gear accessible with one hand.

Redshift Quickdraw Saddle Bag

The Redshift Quickdraw is an innovative saddle bag that features one handed access. You can hold the bike while removing or attaching the bag with the other. Or, if you have one hand, you don’t need another. An internal magnet holds the bag securely in place while you compress and lock it in place with the single main strap. There is no more tedious looping around saddle rails to reattach. The bag unzips and opens like a book which makes it easy to access gear without the risk of it all falling out. The high-visibility interior lining makes it easy to see everything that is organized within the interior patches. The bag mounts securely to the saddle rails alone and does not contact the seatpost, ensuring flawless operation on dropper posts and suspension seatposts.

Quickdraw Quick Hits

  • Material: Abrasion-resistant fabric with reflective elements & durable weather proof zipper and construction
  • Two sizes: a smaller size for road and narrow gravel tubes, and a larger size for MTB and larger gravel tubes
  • Weight: 106g and 114g
  • Multi-Bike Versatility: Purchase a second strap for another bike and seamlessly swap the Quickdraw bag between bikes.
  • Retail Price for both sizes: $69.99 USD
  • Retail Price for additional strap: $19.99 USD
  • Confidence guaranteed: Lifetime warranty and 90 day risk-free trial

See the Quickdraw Saddle Bag at Redshift Sports.
